data.content: # Pick of the stats: Queens Park Rangers v Derby County. Derby County seek an exit from the bottom two as they prepare to face Queens Park Rangers at Loftus Road on Wednesday (19:45 BST). The Rams have only won one game this season to leave them in 23rd place, a single point above bottom club Preston North End but equally one point below safety. * QPR lost home (2-3) and away (0-1) to Derby in the Championship last season, the first time they did so versus the Rams in a league campaign since 2016-17. * Derby are looking to win back-to-back league visits to QPR for the first time since September 2008. * QPR have only won one of their last seven home league games (D3 L3), beating Cardiff 2-1 in September. * Since the start of February, Derby have lost eight and won just three of their 12 Championship away games, drawing 1-1 at Burnley most recently.
